newsitem.title: USA: IPO PRICING - Kilroy at $23 a share.
newsitem.headline: IPO PRICING - Kilroy at $23 a share.

text.p: Shares of Kilroy Realty Corp were priced at $23 a share for their initial public offering on Wednesday, the high end of their estimated pricing range of $22 to $23, according to lead underwriter Prudential Securities.
The shares are due to begin trading later today on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "KRC".

Prudential Securities said the number of shares was raised to 12.5 million from its initial estimate of 11.3 million shares. The range was lifted to $22 to $23 from the first estimated range of $19 to $21, it said.
The real estate investment trust is based in El Segundo, California.
